data.narrative:
Solugen is a Series D climate and energy technology company founded by Gaurab Chakrabarti and Sean Hunt that has raised $640M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public peer company in the Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy at similar or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the $640M total capital raised as a proxy base valuation and applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical for Series D advancement, yielding $960M. The peer-median method examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $700M (Amogy, Series C) to $6.0B (Redwood Materials, Series D), producing a median valuation of $2.0B.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $816M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.5B. The 183% spread between low and high reflects material uncertainty around stage-progression timing relative to peer benchmarking, particularly given the wide dispersion in the peer set ($700M to $6.0B). Key variables include the degree to which Solugen's stage advancement and operational progress align with top-quartile comparables like Redwood Materials versus mid-range peers.
